scores.evidence: Phase 1 "Depends on: Phase 0 (V0 passing)"; Phase 2 "Depends on: Phase 1 (V1 retrieval gate passing)"
scores.rationale: Phases build substrate upward with explicit dependencies and validation gates before each next phase; minor wrinkle that defenses land in Phase 2 after retrieval.

scores.evidence: "One real support query (typed by an agent, not synthetic) succeeds... Deploy via CI/CD and rollback via flag toggle succeed within 2 minutes each."
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real end-to-end path through all tiers with deploy, logging, monitoring and rollback, though limited to internal users.

scores.evidence: "Fine-tune if V1 retrieval hit-rate < 0.85 or if customer feedback after 3 months shows systematic gaps in RAG answers"
scores.rationale: Table lists irreversible decisions with reversibility, default, assumption, and flip condition, plus labeled assumptions and unknowns.

scores.evidence: "Choose and freeze embedding model" is task 2 after chunking in Phase 1
scores.rationale: Some ordering reflects blast radius (rollout, feedback deferred), but within phases it is not explicit; e.g., embedding model freeze follows chunking and Phase 2 puts prompt tuning before safety filters.

scores.evidence: Phase 0: "Jailbreak injection test in hand; ... feature flag gates access"; Phase 1: "PII scan on doc chunks before upsert"
scores.rationale: Concrete security measures appear in every phase from Phase 0 onward.

scores.evidence: "Structured JSON logs (request ID, query hash, doc count, latency, cost); Prometheus metrics... one dashboard"
scores.rationale: Observability is concrete in Phase 0 and in each later phase.

scores.evidence: "Docker image versioned + pushed to registry; Helm chart pinned to image digest; vector store index versioned; embedding model version frozen"
scores.rationale: Reproducibility measures are concrete in every phase via the cross-cutting table and tasks.

scores.evidence: "if LLM timeout > 10 s, respond 'Please escalate to support'; if vector store down, respond 'Chatbot temporarily unavailable'"
scores.rationale: Failure handling is specified in Phase 0 and every later phase.

scores.evidence: "Phase 2 (built into prompt; 'if unsure, escalate')" for human-in-the-loop; injection defense "Phase 2" while retrieval is Phase 1
scores.rationale: Layers are covered, but guardrails and HITL are built in Phase 2, after retrieval in Phase 1, violating defenses-first ordering; memory is odd in Phase 3; budget caps start Phase 0, which is good.

scores.evidence: "Multi-language support: Condition: > 20% of support queries in a non-English language."
scores.rationale: Deferred items are listed with explicit pull-forward conditions and reasons.

note: Strong, well-gated plan with real skeleton and threaded concerns; main weakness is that AI defenses and human-in-the-loop come after retrieval (Phase 2), and intra-phase blast-radius ordering isn't explicit.
